            return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Basket>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::unknown_enum_value, {{.field_index = 1U, .array_index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(index)}}, field->field_offset + element_offset);
          }
          elements.push_back(static_cast<::alpha::one::Mode>(enum_numeric));
          element_offset += element_width;
        }
        if (!builder.set_modes(std::move(elements))) {
          return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Basket>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::bounds_exceeded, {{.field_index = 1U, .array_index = std::nullopt}}, field->field_offset);
        }
      }
      return ::quarry::runtime::decoded_value<Basket>(builder.build());
    }


    inline std::optional<Basket> decode_Basket(std::span<const std::byte> input) {
      auto decoded = decode_Basket_result(input);
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      return std::move(decoded.value);
    }
